build_random_nn_transformation_tree: build a RandomNNTransformationTree with specified depth, degree, hidden sizes, and nonlinearity type
get_transformation_from_tree: get a random Transformation from the tree excluding or restricting to specific transformations
edit_transformation_path: edit an existing transformation by randomly altering its path within a distance range
compute_transformation_similarity: compute the Wu-Palmer similarity between two transformations based on their leaf nodes
get_path_description: get a string description of a tree path joining node names with arrow separators
